deck.ko: 빨래방 문을 잡아 주며 웃는, 이웃 같은 퀼팅과 줄무늬 차림.
deck.en: Holding the laundromat door with a grin, in quilting and stripes.
deck.de: Die Tür zum Waschsalon aufhalten, mit einem Grinsen, in Stepp und Streifen.

intro.ko: 빨래방 문을 열어 뒤따라오는 이웃을 기다립니다. 네이비 퀼팅 재킷 안의 회색·네이비 줄무늬와 아이보리 칼라가 단정한 층을 만듭니다.
intro.en: He holds the laundromat door for the neighbour behind him. Inside the navy quilted jacket, grey-and-navy stripes and an ivory collar build neat layers.
intro.de: Er hält die Tür des Waschsalons für den Nachbarn hinter ihm auf. In der marineblauen Steppjacke bilden grau-marineblaue Streifen und ein elfenbeinfarbener Kragen ordentliche Lagen.

body.ko: 아이보리 칼라 이너까지 더해 목과 몸통을 따뜻하게 감쌉니다.
body.en: Finish the layers with ivory collared underlayer.
body.de: Elfenbeinfarbenes Oberteil mit Kragen ergänzt die Lagen.

tip.ko: 오트밀 스카프처럼 밝은 색을 목에 두면 네이비와 올리브 조합이 칙칙해 보이지 않아요.
tip.en: A light shade at the neck, like oatmeal, keeps navy and olive from looking dull.
tip.de: Ein heller Haferton am Hals verhindert, dass Marine und Oliv trüb wirken.

ko.deck: 네이비 퀼팅 재킷에 그레이·네이비 스트라이프 니트을 겹친 초겨울 캐주얼.
ko.intro: 기온 6°C, 체감 3°C의 흐린 낮을 위한 차림입니다.
ko.tip: 니트 위에 입고 앞섶을 살짝 열어 레이어를 보여주세요.

en.deck: Navy quilted jacket over gray and navy striped knit for an early-winter casual look.
en.intro: For an overcast day at 6°C that feels like 3°C.
en.tip: Wear it over knitwear and leave the front slightly open to show the layer.

de.deck: Marineblaue Steppjacke über Grau-marineblauer Streifenpullover für einen lässigen Start in den Winter.
de.intro: Für einen bedeckten Tag bei 6 °C, gefühlt 3 °C.
de.tip: Über Strick tragen und vorne leicht offen lassen, damit die Schicht sichtbar bleibt.

copy.rewriteReason: b222 Claude Code copy rewrite under design/IMAGE_MAPPING_HANDOFF.md 5-1: delivered intro and tip were one sentence for all 10 looks (tip = the outer's how-to-wear), product how-to-wear used 9 template sentences for 66 products, decks listed product names (ko particle error '니트을', de case errors). Titles, pulls, bodies and product names/descriptions are kept verbatim; rewritten fields keep the delivered text in source* fields. Written from the 10 approved editorials.
